predecessors.name: Xinglongwa culture
predecessors.text: Aohan Banner, Chifeng, Inner Mongolia: the type site of the Xinglongwa and the Zhaobaogou

successors.name: Hongshan culture
successors.text: the Chifeng part of the Zhaobaogou country and the cells where the Zhaobaogou and Hongshan discs meet

ledger.x: 5400 BCE: the Zhaobaogou culture appears in the Luan valley and at Aohan ("(5400-4500 BC)"), after the Xinglongwa of Chifeng.
5400 BCE: the Zhaobaogou takes over the Xinglongwa country at Aohan, Chifeng (Xinglongwa infobox "Followed by: Zhaobaogou culture").
4700 BCE: the Hongshan begins in the West Liao basin and holds the Chifeng country of the Zhaobaogou ("c.
4500 BCE: the Zhaobaogou culture ends ("(5400-4500 BC)"); no follower is named on its page.

certainty.note: No border is recorded; known from a type site and a river valley.
